quarterly_data.signal: Amgen and AstraZeneca announced positive topline results of the Phase 3 CROSSING trial of TEZSPIRE (tezepelumab-ekko), given subcutaneously every four weeks at one of two doses, in adults and adolescents with symptomatic, uncontrolled eosinophilic esophagitis: it met both co-primary endpoints (histologic remission and frequency / severity of dysphagia on the DSQ) and all key secondary endpoints at week 24, sustained through week 52, with safety consistent with its approved indications. Full results to be shared with regulators and at a medical meeting. R&D head Jay Bradner: efficacy in a third epithelial-driven inflammatory disease.
quarterly_data.figure: co-primary and all key secondary endpoints met at week 24, sustained through week 52
